study type: Cross-sectional study using retrospectively collected early life data
exposure: infections during the first 4 weeks after birth
cohort: The study included 15,577 children aged 2-11.9 years from the IDEFICS study, whose parents completed questionnaires on pregnancy, early childhood, and ADHD diagnosis.
finding: Maternal age under 20, pregnancy-induced hypertension, and infections during the first 4 weeks after birth were found to be associated with an increased risk of ADHD in children, in addition to confirming the association with maternal smoking during pregnancy.
